tools.name: list_maps
tools.description: List the Travel Tracker maps (checklists) with how many places each contains.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find places by name in any supported language, alias or ISO code, and get the exact name Travel Tracker uses for them. Use the returned `name` with the other tools.

tools.name: get_place_intro
tools.description: Short introduction to a place, in the requested language when available (falls back to English). Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0: credit the returned source when quoting it.
